name: @omiologic/secret-scan
description: Deterministic secret detection and redaction for browser and server JavaScript/TypeScript applications.

scripts.js:test: npm run js:build && vitest run --root packages/javascript
scripts.ci: npm run decisions:validate && npm run python:check && npm run matrix:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run js:typecheck && npm run js:test
scripts.decisions:validate: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_validate_decisions.py' && python3 -B scripts/validate-decisions.py
scripts.python:check: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_check_python_package.py' && python3 -B scripts/check-python-package.py
scripts.matrix:check: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_check_qualification_matrix.py' && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_record_artifact_inventory.py' && python3 -B scripts/check-qualification-matrix.py
scripts.rust:check: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p 'test_check_rust_workspace.py' && python3 -B scripts/check-rust-workspace.py
